question: Under source-native lane wording and strictly conditional decimal normalization, can a hidden higher-precision rate whose four-place display remains unchanged yield the two original Xing L35 coefficient glyph streams? Does the source phrase actually license an exact 820 reciprocal for both 疾 and 遲 lanes?

primary_text_provenance.source: NLC892-CBM1408-371933 邢雲路《古今律曆考》卷45 NLC printed source, Commons public domain digital surrogate, vol14 PDF
primary_text_provenance.original_p73_literal: 右置八百二十以遲行度而一為捷法
primary_text_provenance.original_copy_and_edition_provenance: Not further authenticated; original photographic/OCR scans previously registered, no new page download or native-pixel review in this batch

philology_scope.source_native_820_divisor_expression: Explicitly names 遲; applying the identical operator to 疾 is an UNPROVED extension, even though two parallel headers and numeric coincidences exist.
philology_scope.reference_crosswalk: 13TM separates 損益捷法 from 遲疾捷法; neither is equal to a raw motion value by name alone.

math_assumptions_and_exact_interval.model_only: NOT SOURCE-NATIVE RADIX PROOF. Let displayed four-place rate be integer r0, printed five-place coefficient be integer c, N=8200000000. For hidden real rate R (same 1e4 rate-index scale) use F(R)=N/R. Operator FLOOR: c<=F(R)<c+1, so R belongs to (N/(c+1),N/c]. Operator HALF_UP: c-0.5<=F(R)<c+0.5, so R belongs to (2N/(2c+1),2N/(2c-1)].
math_assumptions_and_exact_interval.rate_display_four_digits_assumption: TRUNCATE R to r0 implies r0<=R<r0+1; NEAREST R to r0 implies r0-1/2<=R<r0+1/2. Both are hypothetical display rules.
math_assumptions_and_exact_interval.not_inference_of_native_miao_rational: Printed native 微/秒 place-value, carry and intermediate scale remain unresolved.
math_assumptions_and_exact_interval.decimal_approximation_policy: Approximation fields are for readability; exact rational numerator/denominator determine all interval and intersection tests.

robustness_to_l35_ji_two_faint_final_gly.unread_last_two_test: ALLOW_EVERY_INTEGER c IN [697500,697599] WITHOUT USING THE TWO FAINT TERMINAL GLYPHS

decision.chi: Under declared hypothetical N/R normalization, the L35 遲 printed c=805967 admits hidden R approximately 10174.101205–10174.113829 if coefficient FLOOR (or 10174.107517–10174.120141 if HALF_UP). Both lie within the same four-digit displayed r0=10174 whether rate display was truncated or nearest rounded. Thus prior integer-only failure does NOT exclude hidden precision for the late lane.
decision.ji: Under the SAME UNPROVEN cross-lane model, L35 疾 c=697530 requires R approximately 11755.749924–11755.766778 for coefficient FLOOR (or 11755.758351–11755.775204 if HALF_UP), outside the printed r0=11752 four-place display interval for either truncation or nearest rounding. Even unknown two faint c terminal glyphs (697500..697599) cannot restore overlap. This rejects only the single shared operand-plus-four-digit display explanation; the source original 820 clause did not explicitly authorize this JI construction.
decision.source_error_conclusion: NONE: no physical printing error or ancestral arithmetic defect established. Other operators, distinct generator, limit/phase, column convention, edition variants or re-collation may change the model.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A conditional 820 reciprocal pattern in both lanes is not direct textual proof that the original 遲-specific instruction generates 疾 coefficients, nor that Xing inherited G892 mechanics.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Identify a source-original 疾-lane constructor/operand and numerical scale before any cross-lane historical adjudication.

next: Re-collate Xing original L35 疾/遲 coefficient and rate glyphs directly at archive-native resolution; investigate source-native separate 疾 constructor and 遲 input/display precision/carry; separately align G892 limit/epoch. Do not vote G893 six historical target finals.
